visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair wearing a white professional chef’s jacket featuring purple floral patterns on the cuffs stands in front of a white-painted brick wall background illuminated by bright, even studio lighting. He holds a green bag of "Coriander Chicken Nuggets" and speaks with a wide, friendly smile and expressive facial movements while gesturing towards the product. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up focusing on a small white ceramic plate holding several golden-brown, irregular-shaped nuggets. The chef's hand enters the frame to pick up one nugget, demonstrating its size and firm texture under the bright studio light. (3) The chef takes a crisp bite of the nugget, looking directly into the camera lens with a wide-eyed, satisfied expression, emphasizing the crunchiness. Yellow variety-show style captions pop up momentarily at the top of the frame. (4) In an extreme close-up, the chef's fingers pull a nugget apart, revealing a light-colored, fibrous interior interspersed with numerous dark green coriander flecks. The background is a blurred view of the white brick wall. (5) Returning to a medium shot, the chef holds a half-eaten nugget while speaking enthusiastically, his eyes squinting slightly in delight. He uses his free hand to point at the nugget's green interior to highlight the ingredients. (6) A close-up shot focuses on the steam rising from the broken nugget, enhanced by digital graphics, to suggest warmth and aroma. The texture appears moist and juicy. (7) The chef's hands are shown squeezing another nugget to demonstrate its elasticity and density in a tight shot, with the golden-brown breading remaining intact. (8) The video concludes with the chef holding a whole nugget up to the camera, smiling broadly and nodding, conveying a strong personal recommendation in the bright studio setting.
